puzzles.title: Serengeti Lion
puzzles.skill: assemble a Serengeti scene from six interlocking parts

facts.animal: Lions live in family groups called prides.
facts.location: The Serengeti is a huge grassland in Tanzania and Kenya.
facts.heritage: Woven baskets and textiles are important crafts in many East African communities.

puzzles.title: Congo Okapi
puzzles.skill: assemble a Congo rainforest scene from six interlocking parts

facts.animal: The shy okapi is a forest relative of the giraffe.
facts.location: The Congo Basin is one of the world’s largest tropical rainforests.
facts.heritage: Carved wood and woven crafts are part of rich Central African artistic traditions.

puzzles.title: Nile Valley Elephant
puzzles.skill: assemble a Nile Valley scene from twelve interlocking parts

facts.animal: Elephants use their trunks to drink, smell, and greet one another.
facts.location: The Nile River brings life through the dry lands of northeastern Africa.
facts.heritage: Ancient Egypt is remembered for temples, pyramids, writing, and art.

puzzles.title: Emperor Penguin
puzzles.skill: assemble an Antarctic penguin scene from six interlocking parts

facts.animal: Emperor penguins huddle together to stay warm on the ice.
facts.location: The Ross Sea is a cold, icy sea beside Antarctica.
facts.heritage: Polar expeditions helped begin Antarctica’s tradition of shared scientific discovery.

puzzles.skill: assemble an Antarctic Peninsula scene from six interlocking parts

facts.animal: Weddell seals can dive beneath sea ice to find fish.
facts.location: The Antarctic Peninsula reaches north toward South America.

facts.location: The South Shetland Islands sit beside the Antarctic Peninsula.
facts.heritage: The Antarctic Treaty protects peaceful cooperation and scientific research.

puzzles.skill: assemble a Himalayan mountain scene from six interlocking parts

facts.animal: Snow leopards use their long tails for balance on steep rocks.
facts.location: The Himalayas are a great mountain range in Asia.
facts.heritage: Mountain communities across the Himalayas have rich weaving, music, and monastery traditions.

facts.location: Hokkaido is Japan’s northern island, known for snowy wetlands.
